title: Hearing the big bands and Rhythm Kings around the Chicago Loop
summary: Walking the Loop he heard Goldkette, Wayne King, Ted Lewis, Coon-Sanders on radio and a Rhythm Kings band in Lincoln Park.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: there at the Black Hawk, and I used to hear them over the radio, and I was exposed to that. And one time I walked all the way from the Loop to Lincoln Park on west side of Chicago, and I heard a band, a famous band called the Rhythm Kings. And, I'm pretty sure at that time and to this day, there must have been some famous musicians in there, to this day that -- but I didn't know them then. And a . . .
Was it the New Orleans Rhythm Kings . . .
I wonder which one, which one that were Chicago Rhythm Kings were.
Or there were Chicago Rhythm Kings.
